name: Ridge-Elder Fang Will

abilities.name: Lope Burst
abilities.effect: A long lope forward on borrowed wolf speed, pale streaks behind.

abilities.name: Scent Trail
abilities.effect: The borrowed nose lights the scent trails of up to five nearby creatures for a few seconds.

acquire.equipPiece: A single moon-silver fang-bracer on the right forearm (the only equipped piece).

abilities.name: Hamstring Lunge
abilities.effect: A pounce from behind that hamstrings the target: damage and a short slow.

abilities.name: Pack Call
abilities.effect: The elder howls: nearby allies surge with speed and foes flinch. Only the howl, no beasts are summoned (Beast Tamers command no armies).

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form: the whole body becomes a wolf-beastman in grey steel-fur armor: long fanged muzzle, tall pointed ears, thick silver ruff collar, long claws on furred arms, digitigrade legs with moon-scar greaves and a bushy tail; a moon-silver fang sword grows from the right forearm.

equip.weapon: A moon-silver fang sword grown from the forearm bracer; its edge is serrated like a jaw.
equip.armor: Grey steel-fur plate: a silver ruff collar, fanged pauldrons and moon-scar greaves.
equip.hair_eyes: A grey mane swept back into the neck ruff, pale gold eyes.
equip.aura: Steel-teal moonlight with drifting silver fur tufts.

beastNote: Ridge-Wolf Elder (A-class alpha of the ridge)
lore: The will of the elder wolf that rules a mountain ridge: it never loses a trail, hamstrings fleeing prey and calls its pack to the kill.
pitch: The Ridge-Elder is an A-class alpha wolf that never loses a trail and hamstrings fleeing prey. Acquire keeps you human, loping in steel streaks with one moon-silver fang-bracer. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a wolf-beastman in steel-fur plate with a fang sword, at the cheapest drain among the A wills.
untrained: An untrained holder is ruled by the hunt: nose and ears overload, the holder snaps at allies and strain climbs while a trail is held, and the pack call costs extra strain. Canon: a will that is not suppressed or balanced disrupts body and mana core and can eventually kill the holder, so the first Awakening (forced, a spark in the core) is the most dangerous moment and training both cores is the cure.

spirit.echo: A lean upright wolf beastman in grey steel-fur plate: long fanged muzzle, tall pointed ears, silver ruff collar, clawed furred hands, digitigrade lope stance, bushy tail, a moon-silver fang sword.
spirit.look: A cold steel-teal orb with a pale crescent-moon scar across it and fine silver fur tufts drifting round.
